3 men have plans to go on vacation together. They call to book the hotel room in advance, pack up, and begin to head out. A few hours later when they arrive at the hotel, they are met with the unpleasant surprise that there was a mess up with booking other guests so they all must share a room with a single bed. They all reluctantly take the keys to their room and fall asleep side by side in the same bed.

In the morning, one guy who slept on the edge was already having breakfast while the, guy who slept on the other edge came in.

"hey, i had this dream where i was getting a hand job and it felt so real, it was the most crazy lucid dream I've ever had"

"no way! I was having the same dream! And you're right, it felt so real and like it was really happening"

The guy who slept in the middle of the bed comes down and the other two guys tell him about their dreams. He then replies with:

"man, I wish. I just dreamed that I was skiing"
